description: Make supervisor push-verification (ensurePushed) compare-first so an already-landed worker push is recognized as synced-ok instead of a false BLOCKED from a stale compare-and-swap old-oid.

userStories.title: Rewrite ensurePushed to compare-first (read-only ls-remote) before pushing
userStories.description: As the cam supervisor, I need push-verification to read the authoritative remote sha first and treat origin==localHEAD as synced-ok, so that a worker push that already landed does not trigger a stale compare-and-swap rejection (a false BLOCKED that can halt a cycle).
acceptanceCriteria: ensurePushed obtains the authoritative remote sha via `git ls-remote origin <branch>` and compares it to local HEAD BEFORE attempting any `git push` (today the push at host.ts:761 runs first and the HEAD-vs-origin compare runs second). [oracle: grep -q 'ls-remote' src/supervisor/host.ts]

When the remote sha equals local HEAD (worker already pushed), ensurePushed returns synced-ok ({ ok:true, pushed:false }) and invokes no `git push`; the false BLOCKED from sending a stale old-oid no longer occurs. Covered by a synced-ok-without-push test using an injectable git-runner that asserts no push command is issued. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor]

When the remote is behind or missing the branch (worker genuinely did not push), ensurePushed runs `git push origin <branch>` and re-verifies, returning { ok:true, pushed:true }. Covered by a genuine-behind-then-push test. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor]

When `git ls-remote` fails (e.g. transient network error), the path falls back to the current push attempt so the fix neither loses the ability to push when needed nor turns a transient network failure into a false BLOCKED. Covered by an ls-remote-failure fallback test. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor]

The ensurePushed return contract { ok, pushed, sha, detail } is unchanged, so loop.ts (the ensurePushed consumer around loop.ts:1343-1361) and the 'pushed' event (events.ts PushEventDetail) need no change; the existing US-001/US-002 fake-injection tests in test/supervisor/loop.test.ts (from ~line 1528) stay green. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]
No `--force-with-lease` is introduced anywhere in src/ (the fix is a read-only compare, not a lease rework). [oracle: bash -c '! grep -rq "force-with-lease" src/']
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Primary file: src/supervisor/host.ts:749-798 (the ensurePushed closure). Today it does: git branch --show-current -> git push -> git rev-parse HEAD -> git rev-parse origin/<branch> compare. The rev-parse origin/<branch> reads the CACHED, un-refreshed tracking ref, and the plain push at :761 sends that stale ref as git's compare-and-swap old-oid, which the remote rejects ('cannot lock ref: is at <landed> but expected <prior-story-HEAD>'), yielding ok:false. Fix: invert to compare-first using `git ls-remote origin <branch>` (queries the remote WITHOUT mutating local tracking refs or fetching objects) -> compare to local HEAD -> origin==localHEAD returns { ok:true, pushed:false } with NO push -> only push when genuinely behind/missing -> ls-remote failure falls back to the existing push attempt. Extract the git-decision logic into a pure helper with an injectable git-runner (fn(args)->{stdout,status}) so the three scenarios (synced-ok-no-push, behind-then-push, ls-remote-failure fallback) are unit-testable; wire the real spawnSync runner in host.ts. Add tests under test/supervisor/ (a new push-verify test file, or extend an existing supervisor test). Gotchas: (1) ok:false is a REAL cycle-halting blocked outcome (loop.ts:1353-1359 -> blockedResult), not advisory; ok:true+pushed:false is the normal already-synced noop. (2) Root cause is two-fold: push-before-compare ordering AND never re-fetching; both are fixed by compare-first-with-fresh-remote-sha. (3) Prefer git ls-remote over git fetch to keep the check lightweight and avoid contending with other git callers (see memory/orch-no-gitfetch-poll-during-postmerge.md rationale). (4) Do NOT introduce --force-with-lease. (5) Keep the return contract identical so downstream loop.ts + events.ts stay untouched. The worker pushes as its own final step (templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md step 8), which is why origin is already synced at verify time and the supervisor push is redundant in the common case. Bun-only, noUncheckedIndexedAccess (guard spawnSync stdout, which is string|undefined).
